title: Work done by Agent-tool workers and in the orchestrator's own worktrees is attributed to its item in cost
goal: backlog.py cost --rework ID gives a figure for an item worked by a background Agent-tool subagent in an isolation worktree or by the orchestrator in a worktree it made (work/<id>), once the session closes, and land warns no more of 'landed with no work rows' for them. Answers SP-evkj4avq, whose per-item cost reads showed no figure for most items while the sprint's attributed sub figure held the workers' tokens, and BG-6i6pdahh, BG-rqkc66vj and BG-isv7273p landed with that warning.
